title: 2D Brick Breaker Game | REMASTERED
description:
2D Brick Breaker Game | REMASTERED is a relaxing/casual retro game where you shoot balls and break the variously colored bricks. There are also a lot of different powerups to make the game more immersive. The game has 100 unique levels.

• Play the game on the side while watching your favorite videos.
• 100 levels of brick breaking fun.
• 6 different powerups.
• Just relax and keep breaking.
